sources.title: Yanshan University 2026 international student admission guide PDF 2

requirements.ruleText: Be a physically healthy non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport.
Be at least 18 and no older than 25.
Satisfy the nationality-status rules issued by China's Ministry of Education.
Hold a high-school diploma or equivalent with good academic performance and provide the formal graduation certificate before enrollment.
Submit a white-background two-inch ID photo, 30-80 KB, showing the applicant above the shoulders without accessories.
Submit the passport information page; passport validity must extend to March 1, 2027 or later.
Submit the applicable academic transcripts and student-status certificate or graduation certificate; documents not in Chinese or English require a notarized translation.
Submit a personal bank statement showing financial support above USD 5,000.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record.
Submit a Foreigner Physical Examination Record valid for six months.
Apply through the Yanshan international admission system and upload high-definition scans of every required document; mobile-phone or camera images and ordinary copies are not accepted.

requirements.appliesTo: Undergraduate applicants selecting English-taught study whose country's official mother tongue is not English
requirements.ruleText: Submit Academic IELTS 6.0 overall with every band at least 5.5, TOEFL 85 overall with every band at least 20, GRE 300, Duolingo 95, equivalent proof, or evidence that the highest qualification was taught in English.
Submit recommendation letters from two course teachers.
Pay the CNY 600 registration fee.
Optionally submit awards, publications and other evidence of learning ability and comprehensive quality.
Submit the degree-program application by June 15, 2026.
Pay undergraduate tuition of CNY 15,700 per academic year.
Purchase 12-month insurance under the published CNY 1,000 or CNY 1,200 option.
Budget CNY 9,600 for a ten-month shared bed, CNY 10,600 per academic year per bed, or CNY 21,200 per year for a single independent room.
Submit CSCA results before the program deadline for: Mathematics, Physics.

references.locator: brochure page 3 program and CSCA tables
